🏠🇲🇽 MEXICO CITY HANDS OVER 106 APARTMENTS AT A THIRD OF MARKET PRICE

Mayor Clara Brugada delivered 106 new apartments in Gustavo A. Madero — 60 m², eco-tech, built to international habitability standards — for 424 residents. Cost: about 928,000 pesos a unit, financed by zero-interest public credit scaled to what families can actually repay, against 2–4 million pesos on the open market. It's part of a 200,000-home plan for the term at 9 billion pesos a year. Housing as a right, not a speculative asset.

🇲🇽🚆 THE ISTHMUS CORRIDOR IS MOVING — 3,000 HYUNDAIS, ASIA TO THE US THROUGH MEXICO

The Glovis Cóndor left Masan, South Korea on June 22 carrying 3,000 Hyundai vehicles bound for the US east coast — routed across Mexico's Interoceanic Corridor: ship to Salina Cruz, then 72 hours by rail on double-deck Bi-Max cars to Coatzacoalcos. It's the second auto crossing since the March 2025 pilot moved 900 units. The alternative to the Panama Canal that Washington said would never work is booking cargo.

🇲🇽🌎 MEXICO OPENS THE DOOR TO PERU — ON ITS OWN TERMS

Mexico is ready to reopen relations with Peru, Sheinbaum said, instructing Foreign Minister Roberto Velasco to make contact with president-elect Keiko Fujimori's team. But the reason ties ruptured stands: Mexico granted asylum to ex-PM Betssy Chávez and its position on the 2022 persecution of Pedro Castillo will not change. Diplomacy resumes; the principle doesn't move.

🇲🇽📈 MEXICO'S INVESTMENT BREAKS A 19-MONTH LOSING STREAK

Gross fixed investment rose 5.1% year-on-year in April — its first gain since September 2024, snapping 19 straight months of contraction, INEGI reported. Construction drove it, up 8.8%, with residential building surging 16.7%. So much for the "capital is fleeing Mexico" story sold by the same analysts who bet against the peso and lost.

🇲🇽🌱 THEY CANCELLED THE MEGA-AIRPORT. 500 SPECIES CAME BACK.

Where the old regime wanted to pour concrete for its airport, water and wildlife returned — 500 species now live in the recovering Lake Texcoco. "Toda esa agua que vemos ahí hubiera tenido que salir, porque ni modo que tuviéramos un aeropuerto inundado," Sheinbaum said; the basin is the Valley of Mexico's natural flood regulator. The NAIM cancellation, vindicated by the ecosystem itself.

🚨🇲🇽 SHEINBAUM: US MEDDLING SPLIT THE SINALOA CARTEL AND UNLEASHED THE VIOLENCE

The bloodshed tearing through Sinaloa started with a US operation, Sheinbaum said: Washington's deal with one faction to grab Ismael "El Mayo" Zambada fractured the cartel and "generó mucha violencia." Her answer isn't more US agents on Mexican soil — it's Mexican institutions doing the job, with homicides now down to 50.4 a day under a coordinated, sovereign security strategy.

🇲🇽💰 MEXICO WON'T TAX YOUR INHERITANCE — AND WON'T RAISE A SINGLE TAX

Sheinbaum flatly rejected a proposal to tax inheritances — "No estoy de acuerdo con eso" — and refused to open the debate. No inheritance tax, no new taxes, no fiscal reform, while spending on health and education climbs over 20% this year. The 4T funds the poor by ending neoliberal-era corruption, not by squeezing working families.

🇲🇽✊ The owner of Merlín — the World Cup's viral duck — was living with her kids in a storefront. Now she's getting a home. "It's not a gift; through INVI she buys the house little by little." — President Claudia Sheinbaum, Mañanera, July 10 Karla Ivette Gómez lived on Vertiz and Arcos de Belén. Housing as a right, with dignity — not charity.
